conviction_note: Four findings sum to +0.70. The lean is mildly positive: Q2 contains the 4 Sep Onimusha launch (1M sold on day one) on top of a record repeat-sales run rate, and that sits against an IFIS H1 ordinary-profit bar implying only 17.8bn yen for Q2. Pulling the other way, Capcom almost never revises at H1, so the 83bn plan is most likely held well below the 90.6bn consensus while Nomura flags a thin H2 slate, and the yen gained about 3% in Q2, which cuts the ordinary line. The scaled number (p_up 55 x abs 4.5 = +0.45) sits close to the sum because nothing decisive and unpriced was found. The stock bought a 56% Q1 beat with a limit-up (+19.8%) and sold a held plan in Oct 2024 (-5.45%), so the realised move can be large in either direction.
bar: H1 (Apr-Sep) consolidated ordinary profit consensus 59,270m yen, and FY3/27 consensus operating profit 90,581m / ordinary 91,428m against the company plan of 83,000m (IFIS consensus via kabuyoho, read 2026-10-27: https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=9697 and https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=9697). Only one estimate source was reachable, so this is the IFIS composite; company plan from the Q1 tanshin https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260728/140120260728500563.pdf. The H1 split sits in the same table as a stale pre-Q1 Q1 consensus (26,525m), so it may be thinly updated; findings that depend on it are kept small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register 0.96% of shares outstanding as of 2026-10-26, from one disclosed seller, down from 1.02% (covering, -0.06pt) (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html via the sealed baseline). 信用倍率 1.26 (kabutan page, 2026-10-27), so the margin book is not crowded either way. No skew exists in Japan. priced_lean_pct +0.70. Run-up: -1.16% over 20 days and -5.52% over 5 days, a pullback from 4,587 (10-20) to 4,300 (10-23) through the CAPCOM ID breach disclosures. Neither a crowded short nor a crowded long.

findings.finding: Q2 (Jul-Sep) carries the 4 Sep launch of Onimusha: Way of the Sword (1M+ units on day one, company release of 2026-09-07) on top of a record repeat-sales pace (Q1 repeat units 21.26M, 40% of the FY 53M repeat plan; Q1 OP 41.05bn = 49.5% of the 83bn FY plan). The IFIS H1 ordinary consensus of 59.27bn implies only about 17.8bn for Q2, against 13.7bn in Q2 last year with no comparable new launch. The H1 print therefore probably clears the H1 bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY3/27 (released 2026-07-28 15:40) beat the stale IFIS Q1 consensus of 26.5bn ordinary with 41.5bn, and the stock closed limit-up, +19.84% on 07-29 (kabutan stop-high list). The last H1 (2025-10-29) was a record H1 and moved +1.38%. Yahoo EPS surprises over the last three quarters with an estimate were +11%, +31% and +31%.
findings.why_not_priced: The FY consensus (90.6bn OP) already sits above the plan, and Nomura raised its Q2 estimate on 10-08, so part of this is held. But the H1 split in the IFIS table implies a Q2 barely above last year's despite a million-seller launch in the quarter. If the market held a bigger Q2, the stock would not have given back 5.5% over the five sessions into the print on a breach that the company says has no game or card impact.
findings.independence: Separate document: the Onimusha day-one release, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9697&b=n202609080238 (2026-09-08, 1M units on day one, launched 9-4). Consensus: https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=9697. Prior-year Q2 is derived from the IFIS-reported cumulative ordinary profit (22,883 to 36,543).

findings.finding: Capcom habitually holds its full-year forecast at H1. TDnet shows no H1 revision in Oct 2021, 2023, 2024 or 2025, only one in Oct 2022, and its upward revisions come in late April (2024-04-25, 2025-04-24, 2026-04-27). So the 83bn plan, about 9% under the 90.6bn IFIS consensus, is most likely left in place, while Nomura's 10-08 downgrade to Neutral flags a thin H2 new-title slate.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Oct 2024 H1 with the plan held: -5.45% on 2024-10-30. Oct 2025 H1 with the plan held: +1.38%. The April 2026 upward revision (with a dividend raise) came days before the FY print.
findings.source_date: 2026-10-27 (disclosure archive read; individual items dated 2021-10-28 to 2026-04-27)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The habit is public, and the street already models FY profit well above the plan, so a hold is the base case. What is not priced is the tail: with H1 likely near 75% of the FY plan, holding 83bn implies an H2 OP roughly half of last year's, and a revision would be a break from habit. Both tails are wide, hence the range.
findings.independence: Nomura downgrade to Neutral with TP 4,400 (H2 new-title slate restrained, FY only fine-tuned): https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9697&b=n202610080857 (2026-10-08). Revision record also at https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9697&nmode=3&date=20221000 and &date=20250400.

findings.finding: The CAPCOM ID breach (11,774,247 email addresses plus system identifiers; 19 domestic e-Capcom addresses and phone numbers; no card data) is disclosed as contained, with the impact investigation complete (second report 2026-10-23). The stock fell from 4,511 to 4,300 over 10-21 to 10-23. Any cost is likely immaterial to an 83bn+ OP year, and the H1 release is the first place management can quantify it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior breach disclosure at a Capcom print in the reachable record. The stock moved -2.2% and -2.6% on the two disclosure days.
findings.why_not_priced: The drawdown is priced, and the question is whether the print adds a cost. A one-off below the line with no path to guidance is sized at a fraction. The small positive is the relief if the release shows no material charge. Had the market already looked through it, the stock would have recovered to the pre-breach 4,500s.
findings.independence: First report https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20261022/140120261022554474.pdf (same issuer, same event). Nikkei coverage: https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZQOUF238GN0T21C26A0000000/. Both concern the same event, counted once.

findings.finding: The yen strengthened about 3% over Q2 (USDJPY 162.6 at 2026-06-30 to 157.6 at 2026-09-30). For a company holding foreign-currency deposits and receivables this implies a Q2 FX loss at the ordinary line, the line the IFIS H1 bar is quoted on. Last year's Q2, also a yen-strengthening quarter, had ordinary 13.7bn against OP 14.7bn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction specific to the FX line. Q1 ordinary exceeded OP by 0.4bn in a yen-weakening quarter.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a public series and is largely priced. It is filed because it shades the ordinary-line comparison in finding 1 and sits below operating income, so it is sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: Prior-year Q2 ordinary versus OP gap derived from https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=9697 (cumulative ordinary 22,883 / 36,543) and the FY3/26 H1 OP of 39,333m in https://gamebiz.jp/news/415144.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely. Capcom held at H1 in 4 of the last 5 years and revises in late April; the plan is 83bn against IFIS 90.6bn OP. Returns: none expected, with no H1 return action in 2024 or 2025; dividend forecast 23+23. New-year guide: not applicable (H1). Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q1 alone is 49.5% of FY OP against last year's H1 ordinary progress of 49.3%, so H1 progress near 75% would be far above Capcom's own history.

baseline_tension: Mildly with the baseline: priced_lean is +0.70 and short sellers are covering, and the findings lean positive. Against the 5-day -5.5% pullback, which came on a contained data breach. The strongest positive the release could carry is a break from habit with an H1 upward revision (looked for: no 修正 filed, habit says hold). The strongest negative is a held 83bn plan with a cautious H2 slate, the Oct 2024 pattern (-5.45%).
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a series the market already has is held by the price), applied symmetrically: the Q2 strength rests on a public day-one release and a 進捗率 anyone can compute, so finding 1 is trimmed from +1.0 to +0.8.
Rule 1: the guidance-hold negative rests on a public revision habit, so it is trimmed from -0.3 to -0.2. The FX negative rests on a public series, so it is trimmed from -0.15 to -0.1.

Rule 2 (check the sign): the draft was already net positive, and the strongest positive (an H1 upward revision) was looked for and is recorded in baseline_tension. p_up stays 55 and abs_move stays 4.5, so expected_move_pct is unchanged at +0.45.
